Subject: MAP Launch: SOC 2 evidence & data POC alignment — HelioSTx evaluation

Hi Jane / HelioSTx team —

Thanks for choosing Redwood for this evaluation. I’d like to kick off a short MAP (mutual action plan) to get roles aligned and make sure the SOC 2 evidence path and data-handling points of contact are clear. Our goal is to complete technical evaluation and SOC 2 evidence review in ~6 weeks so contracts can be routed by mid-August; we can adjust if you have fixed procurement windows.

Proposed internal owners from Redwood:
- Evelyn Hart — Sales / account lead (primary contact for timeline & commercial)
- Marcus Lin — Solutions Engineer (technical demos, environment access)
- Priya Natarajan — GRC / Security (evidence intake, control mapping)
- Rishi Malhotra — Customer Success (onboarding & rollout plan)

Please reply with your HelioSTx POCs for the following roles:
- SOC 2 evidence owner (who will gather control artifacts)
- Data classification / data flows POC (who can sign off on data handling descriptions)
- Procurement / legal contact for contract routing

Attached: MAP_Roadmap_v1.docx (proposed milestones) and HelioSTx_SOC2_Evidence_Roster.xlsx (simple template for evidence). I’ve also included a shared Drive link for secure uploads below.

Key asks this week:
1) Confirm the three POCs above.
2) Pick a 60–90 minute workshop slot next week for a technical walkthrough + evidence intake session.

Thanks — I’ll keep this light and prescriptive.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0182

Thanks Evelyn — this looks great. I’m Jane (VP of Operations) and I’ll be sponsoring the eval on our side. Quick intros: Mateo Ruiz (GRC Manager) will own SOC 2 artifacts and coordinate evidence collection; procurement@heliostx.com is our procurement mailbox and will manage contract routing/PO. I’m looping Oliver Park from our external security advisory (cc’d) — he’ll help validate our evidence set.

Tentative timeline: we like the 6-week target. Our internal constraint is an executive review the week of Aug 10 — so if we can have contracts ready by Aug 12 that would work.

Two quick questions for planning:
- Can Redwood accept encrypted bundles over S3 presigned links, or do you prefer a managed upload portal?
- For the tech walkthrough, we prefer afternoon slots (PST). Do you have availability July 6–8?

I’ll start populating the evidence roster and Mateo can follow up with control owners.

Best,

Hi Jane / Mateo —

Thanks for the quick replies and the timeline note. I’m Priya from Redwood’s GRC team — I’ll coordinate evidence intake and control mapping. A few operational notes to make the intake painless:

- Preferred formats: PDFs or native exported reports where possible (control descriptions, screenshots, policy docs).
- For encrypted S3 uploads: provide a single encrypted ZIP per control family and send the presigned link to gcs-intake@redwood.com. We will acknowledge receipt within 24 hours.
- If you prefer to use the Drive link Marcus shared, label folders by control group (e.g., C1-Access, C2-ChangeMgmt).
- Please flag any artifacts that are restricted / cannot be shared; we will coordinate redaction requests and an evidence acceptance checklist.

I’ve shared a short SOC 2 intake checklist and our DPA DocuSign link below — please have your legal/procurement review the DPA; sign-off will unblock certain data-processing steps for the sandbox.

DocuSign (DPA): https://docusign.com/heliostx-dpa
Intake checklist: https://drive.redwood.com/s/heliostx-map-uploads/checklist.pdf

Looking forward to the workshop — Evelyn, if you confirm July 6 2pm PST I’ll add an evidence intake slot immediately following the demo.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
GRC Lead, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
